title: Bargain the Ash-Velvet Bargain Market: Pressure Break
description: Bargain the Ash-Velvet Bargain Market: Pressure Break is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). One selected deity from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Lucifer as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the combat step at Ash-Velvet Bargain Market, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Ash-Velvet Bargain Market and reveals: How repeated mistakes become chains. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Ash-Velvet Bargain Market configured as a combat space inside infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals

objectives.primary: With one selected deity, break the first enemy pressure line in the Ash-Velvet Bargain Market, secure the enemy line, and deny the Hollow a foothold in the outer dungeon.
optional: Clear the Ash-Velvet Bargain Market before the route pressure reaches its final warning
Exploit or avoid the route rule: ash markets that offer cursed shortcuts
Resolve at least two contract clauses, debt positioning, chain control, execution through risk decisions before victory
